verdict.rationale: A government business-filing portal could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant or chatbot, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence describes one: the Gateway and tax pages cover only manual filing tools, guides, OHID sign-in and in-person help. The probes show ohiosos.gov and bsportal.ohiosos.gov returning 403 even for robots.txt, so nothing on the Secretary of State's own sites could be checked.
